blocks.text: Kisi bhi atom ya ion ka oxidation number oxidation number ke usoolon se nikala ja sakta hai; oxidation number compound mein ek akele atom ka hota hai.

items: Kisi bhi ghair-mila (uncombined) element ka oxidation number sifar hai: S8, H2, Cl2, Na, Mg aur Zn mein har atom sifar hai.
Compound ya ion mein zyada electronegative element ko manfi oxidation number diya jata hai: HF mein fluorine -1 hai.

Compounds mein bohat se atoms ya ions ke oxidation numbers muqarrar hain: group 1 alkali metals hamesha +1, group 2 alkaline earth elements hamesha +2, group 17 halogens binary compounds mein hamesha -1, hydrogen +1 (siwaye metal hydrides jaise NaH ke, jahan -1 hai), aur oxygen -2 (siwaye peroxides ke, jahan -1, aur F2O ke, jahan +2).
Monatomic ion mein element ka oxidation number ion ke charge ke barabar hai: Cl- -1, Al3+ +3.
Compound mein oxidation numbers ka majmooa sifar hai; HCl aur NaCl jaise neutral molecules mein sab elements ka algebraic majmooa sifar hai.
Ions mein oxidation numbers ka algebraic majmooa ion ke charge ke barabar hai, jaise CO3 2- aur SO4 2- mein.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Hydrogen sab metals ke saath -1 aur sab non-metals ke saath +1 hai. Oxygen sab metals aur fluorine ke siwa sab non-metals ke saath manfi hai; oxygen H2O, Na2O2 aur KO2 mein bil-tarteeb -2, -1 aur -1/2 hai. Oxidation number ka ikhtisar (abbreviation) 'Ox. No.' istemal hota hai.

blocks.caption: Muqarrar qeematein
rows: peroxides mein -1, F2O mein +2, KO2 mein -1/2

blocks.prompt: Na2O mein oxygen, ICl3 mein iodine, NO3- mein nitrogen aur K2Cr2O7 mein chromium ka oxidation number nikalein (Quick Check 10.1c).
blocks.explanation: Na2O: sodium +1 har ek, to O = -2. ICl3: chlorine zyada electronegative hai, -1 har ek, to I = +3. NO3-: N + 3(-2) = -1 se N = +5. K2Cr2O7: 2(+1) + 2Cr + 7(-2) = 0 se 2Cr = +12, Cr = +6.

items: Usool: element 0; zyada electronegative element manfi; group 1 +1, group 2 +2, binary compounds mein halogen -1, H +1 (hydrides -1), O -2 (peroxides -1, F2O +2); monatomic ion = charge; majmooa compounds ke liye 0 aur ions ke liye charge.
